question: Ascent A, 1v2 clutch post-plant, spike planted, 32s. You are Jett (2 Cloudbursts, Updraft, Tailwind available) on A Site. 2 DEF will retake. How do you clutch?

options.label: Reposition off-spike to an angle that isolates 1 DEF at a time, smoke the second line, duel them sequentially
options.explication_courte: In a 1v2 post-plant you are not looking for a double kill: you isolate one 1v1 at a time via an off-spike angle plus a smoke cutting the second line.

options.label: Hold a position close to the spike: kill the first retaker then dash-reset with Tailwind before the second arrives
options.explication_courte: Holding close plus dash-reset after the first kill is defensible and exploits Jett's mobility, but holding close puts you on the spike - the most watched spot.

sources_option.citation: Mobility agents can trade a kill then reposition, but holding close to the spike risks a coordinated double-swing that isolates you against two angles.

options.label: Dash aggressively toward one DEF with Tailwind to take a fast duel and break the 1v2 quickly
options.explication_courte: An offensive dash into a 1v2 puts you between two players: even if you kill the first, the second trades you instantly.

sources_option.citation: In a 1vX, don't push into both enemies at once; isolate one duel at a time rather than dashing between two players who can trade each other's kill.

options.label: Dump both Cloudbursts plus Updraft immediately to hide, with no dueling plan behind the util
options.explication_courte: Spending all util without connecting to a duel wastes it: the smokes dissipate, you are left with nothing, and the 1v2 is no easier than when it started.

sources_option.citation: If your utility does not directly create an advantage for your next action, save it; dumping smokes with no follow-up duel plan wastes them.

explication_longue:
Situation: Ascent A, 1v2 clutch post-plant, spike planted, 32 seconds. You are Jett with 2 Cloudbursts, Updraft, and Tailwind (dash) available. Two DEF will retake A.

1v2 post-plant principles: (1) never fight both defenders simultaneously, (2) use util to isolate one 1v1 at a time, (3) position off-spike so the defenders come to you. Jett has the mobility to reposition rapidly, making her the strongest 1v2 clutch agent.

Optimal sequence: reposition off-spike to an angle that only exposes one DEF at a time, use one Cloudburst to cut the second line, duel the first DEF with the angle in your favor, then reset and take the second. Holding close plus Tailwind-reset (acceptable) is also valid but close-to-spike positions are pre-aimed. Dashing offensively into a 1v2 (costly) sandwiches you between two players. Dumping all util without a connected plan (mistake) wastes every tool for zero return.

Estimated elite distribution: ~55% off-spike position + isolated duels, ~22% close hold + Tailwind reset, ~16% aggressive dash (costly), ~5% dump all util (mistake).

sources.citation: Turn a 1vX into a series of 1v1s; utility should isolate a duel, and if it doesn't create advantage for your next action, save it.
Isolating your duels — never facing both enemies at once — is how pros convert 1vX clutches; the plant timer forces the defenders to expose themselves.
Use mobility to reposition and reset after a kill rather than dashing into a coordinated two-player retake.

_gaps.incertitude: Isolate-via-angle (optimal) vs hold-close + dash-reset (acceptable) depend du niveau de coordination des 2 DEF ; contre des DEF non-coordonnes, le hold-agressif Jett peut egaler l'optimal. Coordination adverse non fixee.
Les 2 DEF sont de position inconnue (retake a venir) ; l'axe exact du retake (Main, Tree, CT) changerait l'angle off-spike optimal. Non encode dans le JSON.
Estimations depuis guides clutch (boosteria, dignitas, hotspawn) ; pas de dataset public sur la frequence isolate vs dash-reset en 1v2 post-plant Jett par elo.
